notes: Single source of truth for failure classification. Read by both the web app (sample mode) and the Python service. Rules are checked in order; the first match wins and later matches are reported as other candidates. Regex captures are positional and named by the 'captures' list. Templates may use {placeholders} from captures or from computed facts (model, provider, duration, http_status, same_count, same_orgs).

rules.title: Still running
rules.summary: This generation hasn't failed. It's still being worked on ({status}).
rules.cause: The job is in progress. Long video jobs can take several minutes.
steps: Keep this page open, or come back in a few minutes.
Don't generate again yet. A second run would spend credits twice.

rules.title: Completed
rules.summary: This wasn't a failure. The generation finished in {duration}.
rules.cause: If your screen showed "Generation timed out", it stopped waiting before the result arrived. Some screens give up after 5 minutes, but the job kept running.
steps: Open the finished output.
Don't generate again, or you'll pay twice.
rules.credits: Charged once, for the completed output.

rules.title: Cancelled
rules.summary: This run was stopped before it finished.
rules.cause: It was cancelled, by a person or by the system, before an output was produced.
steps: If you still need it, open it with the same inputs and generate again.
rules.credits: Not charged for a stopped run.

rules.title: Not enough workspace credits
rules.summary: The run stopped at the credit check, before it reached the model. Nothing was generated.
rules.cause: This run needed {required} credits. The workspace credit pool had {available}.
rules.cause_fallback: The workspace didn't have enough credits for this run.
steps: Ask an org admin to top up the workspace credit pool.
Or lower the duration or resolution to reduce the cost, then generate again.

rules.title: No workspace credits for this model
rules.summary: This model is paid for with workspace credits, and the run had no workspace with credits attached.
rules.cause: The generation wasn't linked to a workspace that can pay for this model.
steps: Switch to the right workspace (organization) and generate again.
If you're unsure which one, ask your project lead.

rules.title: Usage allowance reached
rules.summary: Your usage allowance for this period has run out.
rules.cause: The allowance resets automatically. An admin can also allow runs to continue on credits.
steps: Wait for the allowance to reset.
Or ask an org admin to turn on "keep going on credits".

recovery.label: Needs an org admin, or wait

rules.title: Workspace access disabled
rules.summary: Generation is switched off for this workspace.
rules.cause: An administrator has disabled generation access for the workspace.
steps: Send this to the tech team so access can be checked and re-enabled.

rules.title: No access to this project
rules.summary: You don't have access to the project or workspace this generation belongs to.
rules.cause: The run was blocked by project permissions.
steps: Ask a project member or org admin to add you.
Or switch to the workspace that owns the project.

rules.title: Unsupported file type
rules.summary: One of the input files is in a format this model doesn't accept.
rules.cause: The file format wasn't accepted. For video, use MP4, MOV, WebM, M4V or GIF.
steps: Convert or replace the file with a supported format.
Open with these inputs, swap the file, and generate again.

rules.title: File too large
rules.summary: One of the input files is larger than this model allows.
rules.cause: The upload was over the size limit.
steps: Compress or trim the file.
Open with these inputs, replace the file, and generate again.

rules.title: An earlier step didn't produce its output

match.regex: upstream step did not produce output|Unresolved inputs

rules.summary: This step was skipped because a step it depends on failed first.
rules.cause: The real problem is in the earlier step. Fixing that one usually fixes this one too.
steps: Diagnose the first failed step in the plan.
Run that step again, then this one.
rules.credits: Not charged for a skipped step.

rules.title: Blocked by a content check
rules.summary: The prompt or a reference was blocked by a content check.
rules.cause: Something in the prompt or reference images triggered a safety or content rule.
steps: Rephrase the prompt or change the flagged reference.
Open with these inputs and try again.
rules.credits: Usually not charged. Check your credit history if unsure.

rules.title: Model temporarily out of service
rules.summary: This model is out of service on our side for now. This is not about your credits.
rules.cause: The provider account behind {model} needs attention from the team.
steps: Try a different model for now.
The team has been notified. Send it to the tech team if it's urgent.

rules.title: Model provider is rate limiting
rules.summary: The model provider is getting too many requests right now and turned this one away.
rules.cause: {provider} returned a rate-limit response. Your inputs were fine.
steps: Wait a few minutes, then try again.
Or try another model for this shot.

rules.title: Model provider overloaded
rules.summary: Your request reached the model provider, which turned it down because it was over capacity. Your inputs were fine.
rules.cause: {provider} returned an overloaded or unavailable response.
steps: Wait 10 to 15 minutes, then try again.
Or switch to a faster or different model for this shot.

rules.title: Model unavailable
rules.summary: This model isn't available to your workspace right now, or it's down.
rules.cause: {model} couldn't be used for this run.
steps: Try another model.
Or try this one again in a little while.

rules.title: Our job system lost track of this generation
rules.summary: The provider started your generation, but our job system never received the result. This is a platform problem, not your input.
rules.cause: The job system stopped hearing back about this job. The provider may still have finished it, and that can't be confirmed from here yet.
steps: Wait before retrying. The provider may already have produced, and charged for, the result.
If it fails again, send it to the tech team. The report is ready.
rules.credits: Unclear. The provider may have charged. The tech team can check.

rules.title: Interrupted by a system update
rules.summary: This run was interrupted while the system was being updated.
rules.cause: A routine restart stopped the job before it finished.
steps: Run it again. This is safe.
rules.credits: Not charged for the interrupted run.

rules.title: Couldn't reach the job system

match.regex: jobrouter request error|connection attempts failed|ECONNREFUSED|ECONNRESET|Cannot reach jobrouter

rules.summary: The request couldn't be handed to the job system, so it never started.
rules.cause: The connection to the job system failed.
steps: Try again in a minute.
If it keeps happening, send it to the tech team.

rules.title: Took longer than the time limit
rules.summary: This run took longer than the time limit and was stopped.
rules.cause: Very long or complex requests can hit the limit.
steps: Try a shorter duration or a simpler request.
Or split it into smaller parts.
rules.credits: Check your credit history. Most timed-out runs aren't charged.

fallback.title: Cause not determined
fallback.summary: The generation failed, but the available evidence doesn't show why.
fallback.cause: No rule matched the recorded error, so this needs a person. Rather than guess, a report has been prepared for the tech team.
steps: Send this to the tech team. Your IDs, timeline and this report are attached.
Meanwhile, you can try a different model.
fallback.credits: Unknown. It will be checked with the report.
